scene.prompt: Minimalist 4:5 portrait studio product photograph on a pure flat #FFFFFF seamless white background, cutout-on-ground framing with no frame border. Occupying the left vertical column (x=9.5% to 39%, y=11% to 82.5%), a refined vertical tiered arrangement of three real fragrance bottles drawn exactly as in the attached product sheet — identical bottle shapes, colours, caps, packaging, and printed details: Hugo Boss Bottled Unlimited Edt Perfume 100ml, Dolce And Gabbana The Only One Edp Perfume For Women 100ml, and Hawas Elixir Perfume. The bottles are balanced in a tall, clean editorial vertical stack on minimal matte white geometric risers that blend softly into the ground, echoing a sleek poster silhouette. Eye-level camera, crisp focus front-to-back with deep depth of field. Bright, clean studio lighting from the right and front-right creates crisp natural specular highlights on real glass, metal caps, and liquid, casting soft contact shadows to the left. Photographic realism with authentic materials and zero plastic AI sheen or gimmicky props. Every printed word on the real products must be spelled exactly as on the product sheet: BOSS, HUGO, UNLIMITED, BOTTER, UNLIMI, DOLCE, GABBANA, The, Only, One, هوس, HAWAS, ELIXIR, 100, ML, EAU, DE, PARFUM, 3.38, FL, الرصاصي. No other text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, price tags, or stickers anywhere. Keep pure empty white space over x=70%-90.5%, y=7.5%-12%; x=46%-90.5%, y=30.5%-55.5%; and x=9.5%-90.5%, y=89%-92.5%.

elements.text: Keep it, or send it island-wide.

why_it_works: Preserves the reference's stark white minimalism, left-column tall product silhouette, and staggered four-line headline rhythm for instant two-second readability.
Showcases all three real perfume bottles cleanly on a pure white studio ground without gimmicky props, letting the authentic packaging carry the visual appeal.
Maintains two-tone purple type hierarchy (#340A5C primary, #6B3FA0 accents) and strict 100px margins for a refined, production-ready Kapruka layout.

Mapped reference black and red type colours to Kapruka Retail Purple (#340A5C) and legible light-ground accent purple (#6B3FA0) to preserve the two-tone hierarchy.
